stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_015; bach_uyen music + underwater ambience are the drowned-city cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this scene (S01: wide view of the submerged ruined town, red-tiled roofs under water, stone arch and bubbles, WIDE_STATIC; S02: detail of the dining bowl tied to a stone table, guide rope and a bare diver hand, DETAIL_LOCKED; S03: top-down underwater corridor with a small diver figure in a conical hat at the bottom centre, TOPDOWN_MATCH; keyframes CIN_015 S01/S02/S03). bach_uyen is the composed set's underwater low-passed form (850 Hz) -- the setting-exact cue for a drowned city, for the line about a rope someone tied for the divers before ('Lan truoc co nguoi da buoc day nay cho chung ta.'). Its only previous mix use was the P0 v3 review reel; this is its first scene-mix use. underwater is the composed underwater bed for the submerged city framing all three shots; also first scene-mix use (P0 v3 review reel only before). ben_mua was passed over: just used for CIN_014, the immediately preceding scene. lam_trieu was passed over: the pastoral flute, used for CIN_013. tran_son ('Tran Son — Nguoi qua cua', the bell-led gate form) was passed over: already used for CIN_008 and CIN_012. quiet_discovery was passed over: used for CIN_007 and CIN_011. thang_long is the capital-city form (wrong setting); sa_hoa is desert/dry (wrong setting); rift_finale is the set's only full close (finale material, wrong for a mid-campaign chapter beat); boss_mang_cot is boss material. wind_canopy was passed over: just used for CIN_014; mountain_wind was used for CIN_013, forge for CIN_012, river_shore for CIN_003 and CIN_008 (water-edge, not submerged), waterfall for CIN_009; rain_light and rain_heavy are above-water rain; cave_drips is a cave bed, not an open drowned city; desert_wind, city_night, thang_long_crowd and rift are wrong for this setting. The reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_015_timing_v1.json).

notes: VO window 12.5-17.5 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1. The window is the uniform 12.5-17.5 s; it was NOT widened.

The CP17 VO take measures -23.27 LUFS (checkpoint 17, re-verified from real bytes this run, vs -22.05 LUFS for the CIN_014 take). VO is kept at unity per the recipe, not normalized.

Staging: the timing manifest marks the S03 dialogue onscreen: true for the Diver Lead (NPC_DIVER_LEAD), and the S03 keyframe places a small diver figure with a conical hat at the bottom centre of a top-down underwater corridor -- the intended speaker position. But the figure is tiny and seen from above/behind, so the speaker is not identifiable by face or gear from the picture alone; S02 shows only a bare diver hand at the guide rope (no face) and S01 has no figure at all. That ambiguity is a final-picture/character-lock matter, not a mix defect; the mix does not move the VO.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009/CIN_010/CIN_011/CIN_012/CIN_013/CIN_014/CIN_015 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
